items.content_html: getParagraphsDiff is a lightweight TypeScript utility to detect and extract differences between two texts at the paragraph level. A paragraph is defined as a block of text separated by a newline. Ideal for editors, document comparison tools, or any application that needs to visualize inline changes between two versions of a text.
